services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: A new nonprofit art center with galleries for your ceremony or cocktail hour, an exposed wood-beamed performance space for your dinner or dancing, and a private garden for tented festivities make KINOSAITO the lower Hudson Valley’s most exciting space for unique weddings and special events. Whether your dream is an intimate gathering or a grand celebration, our flexible space configurations both indoors and out bring your vision of your wedding day to life in any season. A four-bedroom, two bathroom fully furnished house on the property can provide a respite for family and friends. blurb: KINOSAITO is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit arts center located within the former St. Patrick’s Catholic School in Verplanck, NY. We are committed to nurturing abstract art across all mediums and perpetuating the art legacy of Kikuo Saito.
